title: Restart level from pause menu leaves the game paused instead of running
observed: After pausing, clicking btn-restart and waiting one tick, mode stays paused and the timer stays at 300 (ticks do not advance).
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode playing).

title: Spike hit with low score wraps score to 65,136 instead of clamping at 0
observed: Score is 0 when the player steps on spikes; after the hit the score shows 65136 (wrapped negative value), lives drop by one.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so score should stay at 0.
